notes.title: 🚨 Search and Rescue — Major Update Incoming!
notes.content:
[h3][b]🚨 Search and Rescue — Major Update Incoming!

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42008029/d832a6394d6817483866b9a27405df86ccff104a.jpg"][/img]

Get ready for a major evolution of [i]Search and Rescue[/i]!
Based on your reviews and feedback, this update is a huge step forward — a complete refresh of the game’s pacing, look, and feel.
[/h3][p]🔧 Dozens of improvements across gameplay, visuals, tech, and UI
🧭 Less luck-based, more control through planning and decision-making
⚡ Faster-paced and more dynamic missions
🎨 Enhanced animations and a cleaner, updated visual style
🎯 Tighter game mechanics for a more engaging experience
🔥 Increased challenge — missions now require more focus and thoughtful planning to succeed!
[/p][p][b]This is a new approach to [i]Search and Rescue[/i] — more immersive, more tactical, and more rewarding.[/b][/p][p]🟢 Wishlist or jump back in
🟢 Invite friends and family to the co-op adventure
🟢 Leave a review and share your ideas — all constructive feedback is welcome![/p][p]The more, the merrier. See you on the trails, rescuers! 🚁🌲[/p]

notes.title: Search and Rescue: Yosemite
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42008029/82219b77e6fc3baa47ee013217851883c4effe7c.png[/img]

[b]Search and Rescue: Yosemite[/b]
This DLC will include huge map of major Yosemite Park trails.
Five times bigger map than Tatra National Park!
All locations, trails, landmarks are based on real environment.

SAR: Yosemite DLC will bring:
- [b]huge Yosemite map[/b] based on real locations
- [b]new Hexes[/b] - travel faster using roads
- [b]new Cards[/b] exclusive for the Park
- [b]new and improved Items[/b] - use Your Snowbike to reach Tourists faster
- [b]new Customization[/b] options and more
There is more to come in [b]SAR: Yosemite[/b]

Available July 2023

[b]Wishlist and Follow and we`ll keep You informed.[/b]



New Scenario [b]Snowmans from Outer Space[/b] will be available soon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42008029/dcd3e0ccf0ce5955afa02126293efdb63357e0f1.jpg[/img]
